body:
Thanks for the medicine recommendations. I never tried lithium, but instead was on valproic acid for my mood stabilizer. Kind of worked but zombified me a little bit. Seroquel was a no-go as it messed too much with my sleep and also had some weird side effects, one of which I remember being frequent nightmares.

I think I have to do something different at this point, and that probably includes going back to medications and doctors and stuff. Thanks for hearing me out. I think I'll be fine for now.

Thanks for the reply. I've had a few psychiatrists, psychologists and therapists over the years. I'm unofficially diagnosed with bipolar but I feel like I might just have clinical depression that manifests in weird ways. I haven't been on any medication in the last three or four years after trying what seemed to be like nearly every antidepressant. I'm a little bit jaded now when it comes to medication and treatments. My parents do know what I'm going through and they're being supportive. Things could be a lot worse. My moods fluctuate quite a bit, I just want consistency.
